entries.source_text: Why do you assume that I need something?

entries.text: Hmm. Don't worry, my simple friend, you have great things ahead.
entries.source_text: Hmm. Don't worry, my simple friend, you have great things ahead.

entries.text: And what do you think of our town?
entries.source_text: And what do you think of our town?

entries.text: It's okay.

entries.text: 还好。

entries.source_text: You've done remarkably well, considering the hostile circumstances.

entries.text: 在这样一个环境下，你已经做的很好了。
entries.source_text: 在这样一个环境下，你已经做的很好了。

entries.text: I'm called Chuck. Welcome to Adytum. I'm afraid that most of the people here aren't too forthcoming with strangers, though.
entries.source_text: I'm called Chuck. Welcome to Adytum. I'm afraid that most of the people here aren't too forthcoming with strangers, though.

entries.text: 我叫查克。欢迎来到内城区。不过其他住民对陌生人可不太友好啊。
entries.source_text: 我叫查克。欢迎来到内城区。不过其他住民对陌生人可不太友好啊。

entries.text: Yeah, I noticed.
entries.source_text: Yeah, I noticed.

entries.text: So, what's your job, Chuck?
entries.source_text: So, what's your job, Chuck?

entries.text: 那么你是干什么的，查克？
entries.source_text: 那么你是干什么的，查克？

entries.text: See you around, Chuck.
entries.source_text: See you around, Chuck.

entries.text: 再见，查克。
entries.source_text: 再见，查克。

entries.text: Good journeys, wanderer.
entries.source_text: Good journeys, wanderer.

entries.text: 一路平安。
entries.source_text: 一路平安。

entries.text: We all need something, don't we? And you wouldn't have talked to me if you didn't want something, whether information, conversation, or perhaps guidance. I can tell that you've been through a lot. What do you need?
entries.source_text: We all need something, don't we? And you wouldn't have talked to me if you didn't want something, whether information, conversation, or perhaps guidance. I can tell that you've been through a lot. What do you need?

entries.text: 每个人都想做点什么，问点什么，对吧？你要是什么都不想要，比如消息，聊天，或是引导，也就不会和我说话了。我知道你经历了很多事情。你需要什么帮助？
entries.source_text: 每个人都想做点什么，问点什么，对吧？你要是什么都不想要，比如消息，聊天，或是引导，也就不会和我说话了。我知道你经历了很多事情。你需要什么帮助？

entries.text: Uh, I don't need anything, thanks.

entries.text: 我只有一个人，但是我已经尽力地帮助他们了，我建议你为了自己的信仰而抗争，但首先，你要确定这是值得的。有时候，一定程度的妥协和企盼往往会带来更大的胜利。

entries.text: 他们会最后毁掉自己的。最后活下来的一定是团结的人们，就像我们。
entries.source_text: 他们会最后毁掉自己的。最后活下来的一定是团结的人们，就像我们。

entries.text: I'm glad that some of the outsiders, like you, feel that way.# We need to find ways to work together to build something new.# It won't start here; we are too regulated, but it has to start somewhere.
entries.source_text:
I'm glad that some of the outsiders, like you, feel that way.
# We need to find ways to work together to build something new.
# It won't start here; we are too regulated, but it has to start somewhere.

entries.text: 很高兴有像你这样的外乡人也能这么想。我们要精诚团结，建造新的未来。也许这里还没开始，我们被管得太死了，但肯定在其他地方会有这样一天的。
entries.source_text: 很高兴有像你这样的外乡人也能这么想。我们要精诚团结，建造新的未来。也许这里还没开始，我们被管得太死了，但肯定在其他地方会有这样一天的。

entries.text: Hello. What can I do for you?
entries.source_text: Hello. What can I do for you?

entries.text: 你好，我能帮你做什么？
entries.source_text: 你好，我能帮你做什么？

entries.text: Can I help you?
entries.source_text: Can I help you?

entries.text: 需要帮忙？
entries.source_text: 需要帮忙？

entries.text: Yes?
entries.source_text: Yes?

entries.text: 嗯？
entries.source_text: 嗯？

entries.text: Just stopping by to say hello.
entries.source_text: Just stopping by to say hello.

entries.text: 路过，问声好。
entries.source_text: 路过，问声好。

entries.text: I'm looking for a little advice.
entries.source_text: I'm looking for a little advice.

entries.text: 我想向你咨询。
entries.source_text: 我想向你咨询。

entries.text: May I ask what you do around here?
entries.source_text: May I ask what you do around here?

entries.text: 你在这里做什么？
entries.source_text: 你在这里做什么？

entries.text: Hello, then. I hope you're doing well.
entries.source_text: Hello, then. I hope you're doing well.

entries.text: 哦，你好啊，祝你一切顺利。
entries.source_text: 哦，你好啊，祝你一切顺利。
